theorems.name: Submission.lpf_wtc_wtt_continuity_error_vanishes
theorems.statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (C : Set (Eucl Q)) (θ : Eucl Q → ℝ) (y : Eucl Q) (φ : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (Eucl Q) ℝ), NullMeasurableSet C (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) → ContinuousWithinAt θ C y → (∃ K : ℝ≥0, ∀ᶠ ρ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) (C ∩ closedBall y ρ) ≤ K * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) → Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (t ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ x in C, φ (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap y t x) * (θ x - θ y) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
